entries.result: CLI help advertised exception level ALL while the installed command accepted DEBUG; no cloud resource existed
the generated CDK packager required project-relative Lambda paths, pyproject files, and uv; local synthesis failures created no cloud resources
matching target names across two configured Gateways collided in a generated CDK output identifier; the planned direct-control-plane second Gateway was never created
three policy candidates were rejected during stack creation; every failed stack reached rollback complete and was deleted before the next attempt
